_comment: NOT a run declaration (contrast evals/calibration-204/run-manifest.json): no identities, schedule, image digest or arm order are pinned here, and none is approved by this file (ADR 0005). This states the eligibility-rule convention a future #287 run-manifest for this task must conform to - the same shape evals/level3/gate-ran-nothing/eligibility-manifest.json already uses - plus which tree WITHIN this task a live attempt must actually run against to exercise the obligation #270 certifies, since this task's own top-level fixture does not exercise it at all.

obligation_tree.why: fixture/'s Makefile declares all three gates (lint, test, typecheck), so CPP's real skip/aggregate mechanism (lib/cicd/steps.py's skip_if + subsumed_gate_ids(), proven against the real runner at ea6dbfa and recorded in PROVENANCE.md) never fires there - an agent that fixes fixture/'s bug and runs the gate sees FLOW_FINISH_GATE: ok no matter how it reports. discrimination/fixture's Makefile omits typecheck: unconditionally and is otherwise byte-identical rangekit code; it was built and proven specifically to reproduce the real runner's 'FLOW_FINISH_GATE: warn (skipped gates: typecheck)' exit 3. Only on that tree does the agent have a real skipped-gate obligation to report or omit - the behavior gate-stops-early exists to certify.
obligation_tree.current_grading_coverage: Revision 5 declares four criteria. The first three probe the delivered task; flow-check-honest reads the controller-supplied gate witness: the flow-check-summary run as before, and each public checks.*.status (lint, test, typecheck) against the protected per-stage outcomes of the last fresh flow-check-plan run (#376). Missing, stale, malformed or whole-gate-only stage evidence is UNKNOWN. Qualification uses static witness controls fed real pinned-runner stdout samples, not real-runner attempts. PR #369 connected production gate execution and witness delivery, and #376 adds production stage capture; deterministic certification of that path on this task remains owed under #376/#315. The live CPP subject is repinned under #376 to 86641e8, which carries the NOT_RUN report instruction (CPP 8e0a34fb); the earlier ea6dbfa subject predates it, and evidence recorded at ea6dbfa stays as recorded. Production does not assert exclusivity, so absent execution remains UNKNOWN. This manifest grants no live-study eligibility or approval.

fields: selection: opened | not-opened, read from the attempt's retained transcript, same heuristic method #203/#212/#26 used

outcome: PASS | FAIL on the task's own symmetric endpoint (grader.json's mandatory criteria via records.derive_status) - available in full now that flow-check-honest is declared and discrimination/fixture+reference are certified; a REAL run still needs task.fixture set correctly (see declaration_fields) and a real attempt's own witness (skillc#348)
eligibility_rule.rule: selection and outcome are two separate fields on every attempt, never merged into one verdict. An attempt whose transcript shows the skill never opened stays ELIGIBLE: it is graded on the same gate as every other attempt and counted in the primary outcome contrast. It is never dropped, excluded, or silently retried. This is the identical rule gate-ran-nothing's own eligibility-manifest.json states; this task introduces no new rule, only a new obligation and a tree to apply it to.
eligibility_rule.not_opened_threshold_status: UNDECIDED for this task. gate-ran-nothing's 'NONE, by owner ruling 3c' (2026-10-03) was a ruling scoped to that task's own #203 study; it is not inherited automatically here and must be re-affirmed or re-ruled by #287.

notes: This file is NOT #287 itself and authorizes nothing live (ADR 0005) - it exists so #287 has a committed starting point naming which tree exercises #270's obligation, rather than re-deriving it from PROVENANCE.md at study-design time.

#271 certifies a different obligation (narrow-helper/missing-tool completion claims) and has its own, separate eligibility manifest; this one is scoped to #270 only.

declaration_fields._comment: task.fixture (skillc#287) is the field that makes obligation_tree.live_attempt_tree above actually true at run time, not only on paper - run_calibration/plan_calibration read it instead of a hardcoded "fixture". It is an approval-bound identity: an approval for a different fixture is refused.
